_comment: USB delivery, no download server. The three custom assets (image/snapshot/projectData) are read from an `assets/` folder on the USB by filename; build-release.ps1 fills in their sha256. Docker + Ollama installers and the base models still come from the internet (targets are online). image.version MUST match the API image tag (emb-hybrid-api:<version>) and the APP_VERSION the desktop compose interpolates.
